convert_gpt2_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert an OpenAI GPT TensorFlow checkpoint to a PyTorch model with optional config file
load_tf_weights_in_gpt2: load TensorFlow GPT2 weights into a PyTorch GPT2Model instance
GPT2Config_from_json_file: create a GPT2Config object from a JSON configuration file
GPT2Config_default: create a GPT2Config object with default GPT2 model hyperparameters
GPT2Model_init: initialize a GPT2Model instance with a given GPT2Config
